prompt: Pixel art animation sprite sheet for a retro 2D action RPG, the exact same character as in the reference image (Musashi, the ronin: black hair in a topknot, short dark beard, faded blue tattered kimono with a white sash, dark hakama trousers, straw sandals, a plain wooden bokken sword). Four frames in one row, equal cells on a flat chroma green #00FF00 background, same size and same baseline, front view facing the camera, crisp pixel art with 1px dark outline like the reference. The bokken must never be held vertically above the head: keep it held diagonally or horizontally close to the body so no frame is much taller than the standing pose. Frames left to right: 1) deep low crouch in a duelist stance, bokken held at the hip with both hands like drawing a sword, eyes locked forward, kimono stirring; 2) rising up, bokken lifted diagonally across the chest with both hands, intense glare; 3) the peak: standing wide, feet apart, bokken held horizontally overhead at head height with both hands, a fierce challenging pose, kimono flaring; 4) lunging forward into a firm stance with the bokken pointed straight at the viewer-side target in a thrust, kimono billowing. Big dramatic readable poses, no text, no letters, no effects outside the character.
